baseline: 65 baseline scenario rows remain unchanged; these 9 are additional acceptance groups, not passes.
scope: Tenant-scoped composable packs across ingestion, processing, retrieval and operations.
fixture_policy: Bind executable cases to exact input/expected-output fixtures before running; no LLM answer similarity or successful HTTP receipt substitutes for graph/evidence assertions.
run_policy: Register runs before execution, record code/configuration fingerprints and observations; report all assertions and linked defects; publish redacted evidence.

scenarios.input: Tenant A selects core+PDLC; tenant B selects core+user; configure distinct authorized databases.
required_assertions: Resolved pack versions, capabilities and database identity match each tenant configuration.
API and workers agree on interpretation identity.
Reordering selection produces equivalent composition.
scenarios.execution: Local production-composition tests first; then Engram on real Spanner for acceptance.

scenarios.input: Valid PDLC fixture plus missing-required-field variant; submit as authorized tenant A.
required_assertions: Valid event saved only in A ledger.
Invalid payload rejected with field-specific error and absent from ledger.
Unknown or disabled-domain admission has explicit ledger-only versus rejected policy; never promises domain processing.
scenarios.execution: Local production-composition tests first; then Engram on real Spanner for acceptance.

scenarios.input: Deliver valid PDLC fixture via production composition roots, including relevant session trigger.
required_assertions: Exact fixture artifact IDs/properties/relationships and Event evidence match expected outputs.
No disabled UserProfile/Preference outputs, user-only extractor calls or related writes.
Core summaries/entity behavior follows explicitly selected capabilities.
scenarios.execution: Local production-composition tests first; then Engram on real Spanner for acceptance.

scenarios.input: Query expected PDLC artifact via A and profile capability with user disabled; seed historical disabled data.
required_assertions: Exact expected artifacts/evidence returned for supported question.
Disabled functionality returns defined outcome, not accidental empty success.
Historical visibility and cross-pack traversal obey explicit policy.
scenarios.execution: Local production-composition tests first; then Engram on real Spanner for acceptance.

scenarios.input: Enable core+PDLC+user; execute domain fixture and supported user extraction fixture.
required_assertions: Each selected capability produces expected outputs.
Both query paths behave as defined.
Shared work not duplicated; intentional multiple subscribers preserve identity/evidence.
No pack-combination-specific dispatcher changes required.
scenarios.execution: Local production-composition tests first; then Engram on real Spanner for acceptance.

scenarios.input: Add unfamiliar supported-capability fixture pack alongside a domain; attempt missing dependency/version/capability and conflicting ownership.
required_assertions: Compatible fixture runs using existing engine dispatch.
No engine pack-name branches added.
Unsupported or conflicting composition fails clearly before processing.
Composition order does not change outputs.
scenarios.execution: Local production-composition tests first; then Engram on real Spanner for acceptance.

scenarios.input: Use identical event/session/agent/artifact IDs in two tenant databases; attempt unauthorized tenant/database override.
required_assertions: Independent ledgers/graphs and query answers.
Unauthorized routing rejected before append.
No cross-tenant search, evidence, cache or worker/checkpoint effects.
scenarios.execution: Local production-composition tests first; then Engram on real Spanner for acceptance.

scenarios.input: Deny access or introduce incompatible schema/configuration for one tenant database.
required_assertions: Tenant handshake reports target-specific failure.
No default database fallback or wrong-tenant append.
Healthy tenant continues according to defined failure policy.
scenarios.execution: Local production-composition tests first; then Engram on real Spanner for acceptance.

scenarios.input: Restart/retry; replay, retain and rebuild A; disable/re-enable selected capability according to policy.
required_assertions: No duplicate artifacts or lost processing obligations/evidence.
B data/checkpoints/ontology state unchanged.
Versioned interpretation, historical visibility and catch-up match policy.
Scoped client/session cleanup and credential reconnect preserve database routing.
scenarios.execution: Local production-composition tests first; then Engram on real Spanner for acceptance.
